_doc: Floor marks for calib_floor.py, in metres from O = the floor point under the RGB lens (plumb line). x ahead along the robot's +x (through the front wheel W1 and the midpoint of W2-W3), y to the LEFT. Click them in this order. y null = distance-only mark: x is its distance straight ahead along +x, not the diagonal (its image row only). check true = held out of the fit, its error reported.
